newsitem.title: SINGAPORE: Griffin oil field maintenance put back one month.
newsitem.headline: Griffin oil field maintenance put back one month.

text.p: Maintenance work at the Griffin oil field offshore western Australia has been put back by one month to May and June, traders said on Tuesday.
The floating production platform at the 70,000 barrels-per-day field has been shut down several times in recent months owing to storms, delaying lifting schedules.
The six-week maintenance work had been slated to start April 1 but will now start early in May, the traders said.
The field is operated by Broken Hill Pty Ltd, which holds a 45-percent stake in the consortium. Mobil Corp of the United States holds 35 percent and Inpex Alpha Ltd the remaining 20 percent.
